title: Bhujangasana Ka Zamaana!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

KAMAR BHAI.look: A slightly curved, muscly brown back, with a small, cheerful face painted on it. Wearing a tiny red bandana.

HADDIYAN DIDI.look: A smiling, slender bone figure, made of white, smooth material, with a small, wise face. Wearing a cute pink bow.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] on a yoga mat, looking energetic, ready to stretch.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai! Main hoon Kamar Bhai, tumhari peeth ki shaan!
scenes.say: अरे भाई! मैं हूँ कमर भाई, तुम्हारी पीठ की शान!

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] on a yoga mat, looking energetic, ready to stretch.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Pet ke bal let ja, fir dekho mera kamaal.
scenes.say: पेट के बल लेट जा, फिर देखो मेरा कमाल.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] on a yoga mat, looking energetic, ready to stretch.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Dheere se chhati utha, zyada zor nahi lagane ka.
scenes.say: धीरे से छाती उठा, ज़्यादा ज़ोर नहीं लगाने का.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] standing beside Kamar Bhai, looking gentle and supportive.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Hi! Main hoon Haddiyan Didi, harr haddi ki dost.
scenes.say: हाय! मैं हूँ हड्डियां दीदी, हर हड्डी की दोस्त.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] standing beside Kamar Bhai, looking gentle and supportive.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Bhujangasana matlab body ko halka sa stretch.
scenes.say: भुजंगासन मतलब बॉडी को हल्का सा स्ट्रेच.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] standing beside Kamar Bhai, looking gentle and supportive.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Dard ho toh tension nahi lene ka, ruk jaane ka.
scenes.say: दर्द हो तो टेंशन नहीं लेने का, रुक जाने का.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] now slightly curved upwards, looking proud.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Sahi se karega toh, teri kamar ko milega aaram.
scenes.say: सही से करेगा तो, तेरी कमर को मिलेगा आराम.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] now slightly curved upwards, looking proud.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Aaram se saans le, aur upar dekh ekdum.
scenes.say: आराम से सांस ले, और ऊपर देख एकदम.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] now slightly curved upwards, looking proud.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Din bhar ki thakaan, bole toh chhoo-mantar.
scenes.say: दिन भर की थकान, बोले तो छू-मंतर.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] pointing gently at Kamar Bhai, a little concerned look.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Lekin bhidu, zyada kheench-taan nahi karne ka.
scenes.say: लेकिन भिड़ू, ज़्यादा खींच-तान नहीं करने का.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] pointing gently at Kamar Bhai, a little concerned look.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Agar lafda ho ya BP badhe, doctor ko dikhaane ka.
scenes.say: अगर लफड़ा हो या बीपी बढ़े, डॉक्टर को दिखाने का.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] pointing gently at Kamar Bhai, a little concerned look.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Haddiyon ko hamesha pyaar se sambhaalne ka.
scenes.say: हड्डियों को हमेशा प्यार से संभालने का.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] showing a gentle upward curve, looking happy.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Sirf chhati uthani hai, pet ko zameen pe rakh.
scenes.say: सिर्फ छाती उठानी है, पेट को ज़मीन पे रख.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] showing a gentle upward curve, looking happy.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Shuruat mein thoda hi kar, ekdum fit ho jayega.
scenes.say: शुरुआत में थोड़ा ही कर, एकदम फिट हो जाएगा.

scenes.image: [[KAMAR BHAI]] showing a gentle upward curve, looking happy.
scenes.speaker: KAMAR BHAI
scenes.line: Ye pose beginners ke liye ekdum sahi hai.
scenes.say: ये पोज़ बिगिनर्स के लिए एकदम सही है.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] smiling, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Sahi pakde hain! Yoga hai sehat ka funda.
scenes.say: सही पकड़े हैं! योग है सेहत का फंडा.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] smiling, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Lekin har cheez limit mein hi acchi lagti hai.
scenes.say: लेकिन हर चीज़ लिमिट में ही अच्छी लगती है.

scenes.image: [[HADDIYAN DIDI]] smiling, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: HADDIYAN DIDI
scenes.line: Aapka favorite yoga pose kaun sa hai, bhidu?
scenes.say: आपका फेवरेट योग पोज़ कौन सा है, भिड़ू?
